mapper.select: SELECT a.* FROM attachment a JOIN vehicle v ON v.id = a.vehicle_id LEFT JOIN vehicle_report r ON r.id = a.report_id AND r.vehicle_id = a.vehicle_id WHERE a.id = #{id} AND (#{manager} = TRUE OR v.owner_id = #{viewerId,jdbcType=BIGINT} OR (v.status = 'LISTED' AND AND (a.kind = 'PHOTO' OR r.status = 'APPROVED')))
